title: Blucon Values over 400 error
symptom: When blood glucose values are over 400 mg/dl, xDrip shows completely wrong values (e.g., BG 475 shows as 50-100 mg/dl). The error occurs every time, not just sometimes.
cause: The issue is likely due to an old version of xDrip; the 13th bit option may not have been activated by default in older builds.
fix: Update to the latest nightly version of xDrip, which should have the 13th bit option enabled by default.
evidence_quote: You are probably using an old version. Please try with the latest nightly, it should be solved there.
